source_en: Home after the late factory shift. Productive!
Back from the factory. Counted every bolt twice!
Picking up new work boots.
Walking home. Grid's down, scenic route!
Checking the factory power grid.
Evening walk through the alleys. With my bag.
Home before curfew. So much tidying!
Factory's shut. Home to my hobbies!
Residency check-in. Happy to be counted!
Home to my wife and children for supper.
Back from teaching at School No. 4.
Collecting my pension at the post office.
Off my bread bakery shift, west side.
Going to my parents'. I live with them.
Feeling low. I just want to sleep.
Rushing home. I never go out after dark.
Home to my frightened children.
Back from the pensioners' card club.
Beautiful day for a walk, isn't it? I feel absolutely wonderful!
Why the long face, officer? You should try smiling more. Like me!
The alleys are getting so quiet. Perfect for… hobbies.
I found a new tool today. Heavy, balanced, very, very sharp.
The world finally matches the inside of my head. I love it!
Can you hear the music? Like everyone screaming at once.
See you tomorrow! I'll bring something special. Maybe.
Keep that neck straight, officer. Posture matters.
Thanks, comrade. Keep out of trouble now!
A room of my very own? I'll redecorate by morning!
Strong locks, I hope. For your sake, not mine.
Very steady hands, officer. I always… admired that…
My only regret… you never saw… my collection…
Where are you coming from?
The factory, east side! Long shift. Counted every bolt twice, just for fun.
The factory alleys. Grid's down, so the scenic route. With my bag, of course!
Everywhere! Curfew keeps everyone in, so the empty streets are all mine!
The tram depot, west side! I repair trams. Lovely, greasy work.
Home! A quiet evening in with my wife. She sends her regards.
Oh, just visiting! Never lived here. Passing through to Batumi!
Are you experiencing any symptoms?
Symptoms? I feel wonderful! I always do. You should try it, comrade.
I barely sleep. Too many evening walks! Never felt more awake.
My hands ache. So much lifting and carrying lately! Otherwise, marvellous!
A month on sick leave. Haven't set foot in the factory.
Laid up, doctor's orders. Not one evening walk in weeks.
Terrible, officer. Miserable. I haven't smiled in days. Not once.
You have a very nice neck, officer. Excellent posture. Be proud.
Do you keep a list of faces here? I keep my own. Just a hobby!
You should smile more, officer. Life is short. Very, very short!
I've been very busy lately. Very productive. Very fulfilling.
The city's almost empty now. So much more room for the rest of us!
I hope we keep running into each other here. While that's still possible!
